annotations.text:
Night Shift — Phase 1 screen set

One story runs through every screen: Sarah Chen in 412 texts that the AC is out at 18:41; Ava raises WO #204; Eli fixes it by 18:56; the inbox prompts Ava to tell Sarah; she does at 19:01. Every frame shows a piece of that loop.

Dark is the default theme. The two "light mode" frames (inbox, phone) show the same palette logic in light; in the built app it's one toggle in the nav, remembered per person.
Inbox — the core screen (design.md §6.1). Countdown timers are the primary signal; presence banner sits above the composer; the green bar is the closed-loop prompt.

Board — supervisors' default landing. Columns mirror the state machine exactly (open → assigned → in progress → blocked → complete); verified and cancelled are hidden behind a link. Speech-bubble icon = raised from a guest text.
Work order detail — timeline is the audit trail (work_order_event). Before/after photos, the linked conversation, and the exact message the guest received.
Department staff on a phone — Eli's list, dark and light. One big action per card (Start / Complete), photo attach, nothing else. This is the screen adoption depends on (design.md §3.1, §6.5).
Analytics — managers' default landing. p50/p90, not averages. Single-hue bars with direct labels; red is reserved for past-SLA. Sample figures.
Admin — quick replies shown; users, departments, assets and categories follow the same table + edit-panel pattern. Greyed items are Phase 2.
Phone simulator — dev only. Be any seeded guest, text the hotel, watch what the server did. The phone is drawn generically (no fake status bar); the log on the right is the real event trail.
Inbox in light mode — same structure and timers; amber recedes from fills to a room-number highlight so it isn't loud in a bright lobby.
A · Ops Console — not selected, kept for reference.
B · Warm Hospitality — not selected, kept for reference.
